 By GMA News Published November 19, 2026 4:34pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Courtesy: Michelle Dee/Instagram Michelle Dee is taking things one step at a time as she recovers from emergency appendectomy . 
 In an Instagram post on Thursday, Michelle recalled how she was on her way to work when she had to be rushed to the emergency room on November 9.
 "As November approached, I already felt that something wasn’t quite right with my body, and true enough, on November 9 I found myself in the emergency room after experiencing sharp stabbing pain in the lower right side of my abdomen while on my way to work,” Michelle wrote.
 Shortly after, she underwent an emergency appendectomy, which marked her first-ever hospital admission and left her with three incisions in her abdomen.

 Fortunately, the operation went well, and Michelle said her recovery has been steady.
 She also reflected on the importance of allowing herself enough time to heal, saying her medical team advised her to follow her recovery timeline strictly and avoid strenuous activities and heavy exertion.
 "Rushing this particular recovery (as I've done in the past) could lead to long term complications which I cannot afford," she said.
 Despite the unexpected setback, Michelle expressed gratitude for the people who have been by her side throughout her recovery.
 "Despite everything though, I'm so blessed and grateful to have the right people around me. To my family, friends, fans, and everyone who's been looking out for me, thank you. The smallest gestures have meant the world to me," she said.
 She ended her post with a reminder to trust God's timing: "All in God's time. Always in all ways."
 Michelle recently promoted GMA Pictures film " Red Crown ," where she appears along with her fellow beauty queens and other celebrities.
 She also graced the The New Nocturnals Halloween party as Cruella De Vil.
 Michelle is set to compete at the Miss Grand International All Stars in December. It will be her return to pageantry after her Top 10 finish at the Miss Universe 2023.
